debt_context.summary: Arm's-length buyer, but a pressured seller: BHR said (Jun 12, 2026) it would sell two or three more assets to satisfy its obligations on the termination of the Ashford advisory relationship, with net proceeds going to Ashford; its Q2 10-Q records a $480.0M fee liability. No formal distress.
No documented trigger: no foreclosure, receivership, lender-directed sale, named-hotel impairment or company statement of distress by Sep 29, 2026.
